one_liner: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes video calls

evidence.claim: Fathom ships a documented public REST API
evidence.quote: This documentation describes Fathom’s REST API.

evidence.claim: REST API resources are authenticated with user-generated API keys
evidence.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website’s settings area.

evidence.claim: API access is included on all plans including the free tier, with no approval needed
evidence.quote: API access starts immediately on any Fathom plan, including the free tier. There is no developer approval

evidence.claim: Anyone can browse docs and start building; OAuth is for partner/marketplace integrations
evidence.quote: Anyone can browse the API docs and start building!

evidence.claim: OAuth apps can be registered by partners and are reviewed for marketplace listing
evidence.quote: Partners can register an OAuth app to be eligible for a future marketplace listing as a Fathom‑approved integration.

notes: Rate limit is 60 calls/min globally (30/min for heavy transcript/summary requests; 30/min for recording downloads) with no option for higher limits. API keys are user-scoped: they access only your meetings or ones shared to your Team; no admin key access to unshared meetings. OAuth apps are subject to review for marketplace featuring. MCP servers exist (github.com/trevorwelch/fathom-video-mcp; agencyenterprise/fathom-mcp-server on mcpservers.org) but are third-party/community, not shipped by Fathom. API surface appears small (meetings, recordings, transcripts/summaries, downloads, token endpoint) based on material reviewed.
